newsitem.title: USA: United Water completes JMM-OSI takeover.
newsitem.headline: United Water completes JMM-OSI takeover.

text.p: United Water Resources Inc said it and Lyonnaise American Holding have completed the previously announced restructuring of their ownership interests in JMM Operational Services (JMM-OSI).
Lyonnaise American Holding is the U.S. subsidiary of Suez Lyonnaise des Eaux, which has a 28 percent interest in United Water Resources.

United Water Services, a joint venture between United Water Resources and Suez Lyonnaise des Eaux, has acquired Montgomery Watson's 50 percent stake in JMM-OSI, which became a wholly owned-subsidiary of United Water Services.
Prior to the restructuring, United Water Services -- formerly the United Water Resources-Lyonnaise des Eaux Partnership -- owned a 50 percent interest in JMM-OSI.

As a result of the restructuring, United Water Resources now has an investment of about $28 million in North America, including both its increased investment in JMM-OSI and its additional investments in Canada and Mexico.
